verdict.rationale: Cekura's mock tools let simulated test calls receive predictable, AI-generated tool responses instead of hitting the agent's real backend APIs, which keeps testing isolated from live systems. A community user praised this for avoiding real-API flakiness and rate limits. There is no documented separate sandbox or test-mode environment, so the isolation covers tool calls only. missing for 10: a documented dedicated sandbox/test environment or test-mode API keys, explicit guarantees that tests never touch production data, and isolation beyond mocked tool responses.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
